dct_title_s: A chart of the northern part of the Bay of Bengal : between Point Palmiras and the Aracan shore

dct_description_sm: Cartographic Details: Scale approximately 1:880,000 (E 85°50'00"--E 93°15'00"/N 23°30'00"--N 19°10'00"). Depth shown by soundings. Inset: Chittigong River. Includes table: Astronomical Observations. Includes 4 coastal profiles.
